title: Chapter 90: Boosting Morale
content:
Chapter 90: Boosting Morale

If you pass the test, you can continue to play. If you fail the test, you will be eliminated directly.

"Brothers, go back to the system town quickly, the beast troops are coming!"

"It's thundering, I have to go back to collect clothes, I'm going to retreat first!"

"The beasts will not attack the system town. As long as you don't go out, your life will not be in danger."

Tian Dao Xiao Qiang: "Lords near Luohe County, our Blade Mercenary Group has applied for a battle. It only takes 20,000 gold coins. Lords who need to request support, click on my avatar to add friends and chat privately."

"I want it, I want it, @Tian Dao Xiao Qiang, I have added you as a friend."

Can you play like this?

Wang Shuo's eyes lit up. He could actually ask mercenaries for help.

He also hurriedly sent an invitation in the group.

Red Panda: "Wana Village sincerely invites all players to come and help. You can choose to join the village, or you can fight as a mercenary or a guild. The treatment is favorable."

"Selling a golden weapon, Scarborough Market, Central Square Trading."

"Golden weapon, I want it... I can't afford it..."

"You look so unsophisticated, our boss already has a set of golden weapons."

"Youyuan.com, welcome everyone to register as a member, I hope everyone can find a satisfactory partner."

This...

The style is wrong!

Seeing the various messages in the group.

Especially those players who chat casually, Wang Shuo guessed that they should be completely flat.

Completely lost the desire to fight for hegemony.

Neither thinking about establishing a territory and competing for the world; nor thinking about establishing a force and dominating one side.

After all, as long as you have a life skill, you can always find a meal.

Working under someone, isn't it all for a meal!

After Wang Shuo sent the message, in the blink of an eye, he was overwhelmed by other text messages.

After a long time, no one contacted him. It seemed that the message had fallen on deaf ears.

Suddenly, the wild beasts in the wild began to roar.

"Roar... Awoo..."

The sounds of various animals mixed together, as loud as thunder!

Wang Shuo was shocked and hurried out.

At this time, all the people in Wana Village gathered in a small square.

Wang Shuo immediately ordered everyone to organize the team.

The cavalry squad was led by Ayub, the militia reserve was led by Hua Tianxiong, and the rest of the personnel were all incorporated into the temporary logistics reserve team, led by Duan Wenxi and Suo Yong.

After the team was organized, the strategic materials were distributed to the corresponding personnel.

As for Dongfang Ling, Wang Shuo did not make any arrangements for her. After all, she was now a guest of Wana Village.

Wang Shuo ordered people to build a high platform with stone inside the wall.

Climbing up the stairs, Wang Shuo stood on it and took a look at the beasts that kept roaring in the distance.

After a while, he glanced at everyone again.

"Dear Wana villagers, this time the beasts attacked the village, which is a major event related to the survival of Wana Village."

"We all came here for the same inexplicable reason. Since we are here, we should make the best of it."

"But we must never accept our fate!"

"Everyone, do you remember?"

"Live like an ant, but have lofty ambitions; life is as thin as paper, but have an unyielding heart; the world is uncertain, you and I are both dark horses; one day, we will surely rise to prominence."

...

"I believe that as long as we are united, we will be able to withstand the pressure and defend our village."

Wang Shuo stood on the high platform, enthusiastically encouraging morale.

"Good." Duan Wenxi applauded.

But the other residents reacted mediocrely. Although they also took the lead in applauding, they were obviously perfunctory.

The scene Wang Shuo imagined was: the residents were excited, moved by his sincerity, and thus their blood boiled and their fighting spirit was high.

Obviously, he thought too much.

"Okay, we'll fight together later. I hope everyone can do their job, cooperate closely, and help each other."

"After the battle, we'll reward each other!"

Wang Shuo finished his speech, jumped off the platform, and asked the logistics team to start using the city wall defense charm to reinforce the outer wall.

At this moment, the roar of the beast began to come from far away.

The battle was about to start.
